original_test_intent: Verify every NVSM subsystem alert-policy property matches the approved platform policy, including status/health semantics and any intentional overrides.
original_method: Pin approved NVSM package; preserve logs; inventory managed subsystem identities and policy schema; run exact `nvsm show policy` read-only; retain raw hierarchy/values/status/health; compare every required device/attribute to a versioned expected-policy manifest, flag extras/missing/unknowns and never change policy in this case.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies and approves the expected policy manifest and owns disposition of missing, extra or divergent entries.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or set/reset policies
Preserve defaults, inherited, unknown and missing values
Do not normalize semantically different states
agent_execution_scope: Compare every scoped property and retain raw output

project_override_considerations: Project policy owns defaults, inheritance and intentional overrides; the review does not invent a universal correct value.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target alert-policy correctness; the absent reference manifest is a project input, while log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and expected manifest can be supplied; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Makes policy correctness versioned and property-complete without turning a review query into a configuration change.
independent_technical_reasoning: A policy display may include defaults, inherited values and explicit overrides that look identical in a flattened view but have different behavior. Comparison must preserve source semantics and require every expected property, not merely scan for plausible text.
